scope: One simplified exploratory survey scenario, as requested after disk-space limit

documents.textEncodingLimitation: Some embedded label fonts lack usable Unicode mapping; absence in text search does not prove absence in the drawing.

survey.dwgReview: Original files rehashed. Authoritative 3DFACE conversion, INSUNITS and source-coordinate checks preserved from the existing verified preparation; no new interpretation of proprietary Civil3D objects.

visualPDFReview.findings: Development layout, coordinate grid, parcel and facility labels; an additional point-coordinate table has not been reconciled with the verified main DWG TIN. No usable rainfall record, drainage invert inventory or confirmed downstream receiver recovered in this review. Unmapped label fonts limit search confidence.

calculation.outletFluxNote: 10-second samples of ANUGA native Riemann boundary mass flux, not the solver numerical-flux integral; regional volumes are diagnostics and their mismatch is reported. Global water balance uses the solver-integrated boundary flux.
calculation.boundaryCondition: Dry exterior at each boundary-edge bed elevation; hypothetical free outfall, no external inflow terrain or downstream stage supplied

numericalFlux.regional: Native DE0 Riemann mass flux sampled at boundary every 10 seconds; checked against integrated global flux

topographicCandidates.method: D8 slope plus priority-flood spill connectivity; closed depressions retained in the hydraulic model
